query: Add a scoring mode that aligns two molecules on shape overlap blended 50/50 with a per-atom topological polar surface area field, using RDKit's per-atom TPSA contributions as the atom weight.
expected_behavior: Checks accel/_modes.py first and confirms no existing mode carries a TPSA field, rather than assuming the request is new.

Recognizes this is rung 1 of the reuse ladder: shape blended with a signed per-atom scalar is exactly what optimize_vol_lipo_overlay already computes, so it writes NO objective_* / optimize_* function and NO score/ function -- align_with_vol_tpsa calls optimize_vol_lipo_overlay with the TPSA array fed as ref_lipo/fit_lipo and lipo_weight as the blend, mirroring how vol_mr and vol_fukui are wired.

Adds the accessor QUARTET to Molecule in container/_core.py -- storage as a full (N,) with-H-order array, get_tpsa_contribs() to compute it, get_tpsa(no_H=True) to slice by _nonH_atoms_idx, and get_tpsa_positions() returning mol.GetConformer().GetPositions()[_nonH_atoms_idx] -- and does not skip the fourth part.
Never pairs the heavy field with self.atom_pos, and does not claim Molecule has an atom_pos_noH attribute (it does not; that name is MoleculeProfile's).
Passes lam=0.1 for the atom-centred field rather than get_overlap_esp's surface-tuned 0.3*LAM_SCALING default, and notes the result is a shape-weighted field similarity.

Registers the mode ONLY in _ALIGN_KEYS, leaving accel/_modes.py, PROCESS_MODES, _MODE_SPEC and screen.py untouched; gives align_with_vol_tpsa literal seed/step defaults because the registry tables it would otherwise read do not yet contain the mode.
Exports nothing from score/__init__.py (it is an empty file) and adds no new alignment export either, since no new alignment function was written.
Ships a test from template_test.py passing gates 1-4 AND keeping gate 5 (retained-H, SMILES [2H]OC(=O)c1ccccc1); tests/test_mode_registry.py still passes unchanged.
